description: This source file contains the implementation of device information API functions for a TR-069 compatible device, including functions to retrieve serial number, software version, manufacturer, model name, hardware version, MAC address, IP address, firmware filename, provisioning code, and power status, among others. It interacts with various system components, environment variables, and external libraries to gather device data.

classes.name: hostIf_DeviceInfo
classes.description: Class implementing device information retrieval APIs for TR-069 interface.
